lines.text: Job says silver has a mine, and iron is taken from the sky.
Far from human habitation, the miner cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man.
The rocks hold sapphires with flecks of gold, and no lion has ever prowled over that path.
The ocean depths say wisdom is not in them, and it cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir.
Abaddon and Death say they have heard a rumor of wisdom, and God tells man wisdom is the counsel of the elders.
